text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen, and Satono Diamond seems to be in good condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She was exhausted after the spring Tenno Sho, so we adjusted her schedule to prioritize her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Satono Diamond notices something off about Kitasan Black when they meet in the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's intense aura from the Osaka Hai and the spring Tenno Sho is nowhere to be found today.
